scope: PROMETEO LAB R1-B — architecture, engines, persistence, Context Foundry, release/rollback and QA
goal: Determine what later Prometeo actually adopted and preserve current technical invariants without creating a second architecture.

durable_evidence.finding: context-foundry-v2 is TESTED_CANDIDATE; part1-runtime-repaired is TESTED_CANDIDATE; the P3 visible product has separate HUMAN_ACCEPTED_CANDIDATE and SERVED evidence; canary, rollback and export pointers exist.
Version numbers are not cross-lineage authority. Runtime-v22 remains the documented persistence/release mechanism champion. Promotion requires exact human evidence.
Part 1 explicitly limited Context Foundry v1 to a selection/privacy kernel and required Part 2 for the complete durable Context Foundry; persistence v1 receipts were session diagnostics only.

Part 2 materialized Catalog truth, Living Lineage, Current Graph, continuity, Context Foundry v2, Context Packs, workflow/metabolism, durable receipts, conflict/migration policy, automatic modification and reincarnation, with local Node/syntax/integrated bootstrap PASS and an explicit non-promotion truth ceiling.

Part 2 composition root validates and composes catalog, lineage, supersession, Current, continuity, books, golden references, durable ledger, Context Foundry v2, modification planning, reincarnation and operator projection.
Pipeline is BYTES -> INDEXED -> RETRIEVABLE -> CURATED -> AUTHORITY -> PRIVACY -> SELECTED -> CONSUMED -> REOPENABLE with fail-closed privacy/currentness/contradiction rules.

Selection is deterministic; explicit IDs do not bypass privacy; derived privacy inherits source restrictions; superseded history is excluded by default; high-authority current contradictions fail closed; consumptions are digest-bound and reopenable.

Browser persistence uses namespaced schema/version envelopes, staged CAS writes, revision checks and migrations; its receipt stream is explicitly session diagnostic rather than the durable authority ledger.
part1-runtime-repaired remains TESTED_CANDIDATE and separate from human-accepted Navigator physics and other product lineages.

Shared architecture was intentionally separated from product identity: persistence, Context Foundry, ownership and engines were modularized while PageKit and product visuals were not flattened or rewritten.

preserved_invariants: Never infer Current, Human Accepted or Served from a candidate, version number, test pass or chat claim.
Authority is scoped: a later visible product can supersede one scope while an older artifact remains the rollback donor or human-accepted oracle in another scope.
No R1-B recovery artifact may become a second semantic owner for Current, Lineage, Catalog, Context Foundry, persistence, release, PageKit, Classes or Student World.
EXISTS != PARTICIPATES: source existence, byte availability, indexing, curation, authority, privacy and selection are distinct states.
Current mission context is a reproducible projection; raw/exact source remains reopenable evidence and semantic similarity never decides authority.
Explicit context IDs never bypass privacy; derived context inherits the strongest source privacy unless an explicit trusted declassification receipt exists.
Superseded/historical records stay out of current truth by default; high-authority current contradictions fail closed.
Context selection must be deterministic and explain inclusion/exclusion; context consumption must leave digest-bound evidence and reopen handles.
Browser persistence uses schema/versioned envelopes and staged CAS/revision conflict detection; migrations fail on missing, ambiguous or cyclic paths.
Session diagnostics are not the durable receipt ledger.
Current pointer changes require known receipt evidence; Human Accepted and Served transitions require evidence appropriate to those states.
Build IDs alone do not prove semantic restore compatibility when catalog/source bytes are independently loaded.
Automatic modifications require a registered writable target; missing source resolution fails rather than inventing a file.
Architecture improvements may not justify visible/interaction regression or flatten distinct product visual systems.
PageKit capability candidates, rollback fossils and whole-UX acceptance remain separate concepts.
Release, canary, acceptance, serving, rollback proof and export are distinct evidence gates, not synonyms.
Private transcripts, LOCAL context, credentials and private runtime payloads remain outside public recovery artifacts.

material_conclusion: R1-B should survive as recovered invariants and routing, not as a resurrected competing architecture. The later repository already contains the strongest durable realization of its architecture: Part 2 tested-candidate platform modules plus later P3 release evidence. No product code mutation is justified by R02 alone.
next_safe_frontier: Future work should consume this recovery map and modify only the concrete scoped owner when a real defect or requested feature appears. If exact historical R1-B package bytes are later found, ingest them as historical evidence and compare against this map without promoting them automatically.
human_boundary: Only exact Human Accepted/Current/Served promotion, product-specific visual acceptance, or retrieval of missing historical private/source bytes requires human/external action.
